The main takeaway from our work is that

intercalating potassium into Sc$_3$ N@C$_{ 80 }$ thin films results in an additional channel for the relaxation of optically excited charge- transfer excitons, which leads to a faster exciton dissociation and a higher charge carrier generation efficiency.
intercalation of molecular thin films with alkali metal cations is a viable approach to improve their optoelectronic properties.
